record.field: Empleados sin aviso de entrada del IESS

# Empleados de Ecuador con contrato vigente que no tienen el aviso de entrada en ninguna de sus versiones. employees = self.env['hr.employee'].search([ ('company_id', 'in', self.env.companies.filtered(lambda company: company.country_id.code == 'EC').ids), ]).filtered(lambda employee: employee.is_in_contract and employee.version_id.sudo().structure_type_id.country_id.code == 'EC') notices = self.env['ir.attachment'].sudo().search([ ('res_model', '=', 'hr.version'), ('res_field', '=', 'l10n_ec_iess_entry_notice_file'), ('res_id', 'in', employees.sudo().version_ids.ids), ]) employees_with_notice = self.env['hr.version'].sudo().browse(notices.mapped('res_id')).employee_id employees_without_notice = employees - employees_with_notice if employees_without_notice: warning_count = len(employees_without_notice) warning_records = employees_without_notice
Empleados con contrato terminado sin aviso de salida del IESS

# Contratos de Ecuador terminados en los ultimos 90 dias, de empleados que ya no estan en contrato, # sin aviso de salida en ninguna de sus versiones. today = date.today() ended_versions = self.env['hr.version'].sudo().search([ ('company_id', 'in', self.env.companies.filtered(lambda company: company.country_id.code == 'EC').ids), ('structure_type_id.country_id.code', '=', 'EC'), ('contract_date_end', '>=', today - relativedelta(days=90)), ('contract_date_end', '<=', today), ]) employees = ended_versions.employee_id.filtered(lambda employee: not employee.is_in_contract) notices = self.env['ir.attachment'].sudo().search([ ('res_model', '=', 'hr.version'), ('res_field', '=', 'l10n_ec_iess_termination_notice_file'), ('res_id', 'in', employees.version_ids.ids), ]) employees_with_notice = self.env['hr.version'].sudo().browse(notices.mapped('res_id')).employee_id employees_without_notice = self.env['hr.employee'].browse((employees - employees_with_notice).ids) if employees_without_notice: warning_count = len(employees_without_notice) warning_records = employees_without_notice
